gloss: with effort, at great pains, long-awaited

definitions.explanation: Indicating that something required considerable effort or trouble; often implying the effort may be wasted.
Going out of one's way to do something; taking special trouble.
A rare or precious opportunity that shouldn't be wasted.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I came all this way but it was closed.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|さ}めて→冷める：02114_sameru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The food I took the trouble to make has gotten cold.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}わなかった→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I went to the trouble of buying it, but never used it even once.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧んだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いって→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Since you came all this way, please take your time and relax.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Since you've gone to the trouble, I'll have some.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Since we've come all the way to Kyoto, let's go see a shrine.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{折角|せっかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Since it's a precious day off, let's go out.

examples.japanese: {折角|せっかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Since it's such a rare opportunity, please do participate.

notes:
{折角|せっかく} expresses that effort has been made or an opportunity is special/rare. It often appears in two patterns:

1. EXPRESSING WASTED EFFORT:
{折角|せっかく}〜⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ (despite taking the trouble to...)
Implies disappointment when effort doesn't pay off.

2. EXPRESSING RARE OPPORTUNITY:
{折角|せっかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧ (since it's such a rare ~)
Encourages making the most of a special chance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {折角|せっかく}〜⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧: even though I/you took the trouble to...
- {折角|せっかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: rare opportunity
- {折角|せっかく}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since you've gone to the trouble (polite acceptance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {折角|せっかく} vs. わざわざ: {折角|せっかく} focuses on the value of the effort or opportunity itself, often with regret if it goes to waste (senses 1 and 3). わざわざ focuses on the fact that someone went out of their way when it wasn't strictly necessary, and is common in expressions of thanks (わざわざ⟦{来|き}てくれてありがとう→来る：00254_kuru⟧, thanks for coming all this way). The two overlap in sense 2 ({折角|せっかく}⟦{来|き}てくれた→来る：00254_kuru⟧ and わざわざ⟦{来|き}てくれた→来る：00254_kuru⟧ are both natural), but only {折角|せっかく} works for a wasted opportunity ({折角|せっかく}⟦{買|か}ったのに→買う：00489_kau⟧, not わざわざ).
